buildCommand:
set -o pipefail
printf '%s\n' "${NKECTL_COMMIT:?}" > bin/SOURCE_COMMIT
unset CAPI_VERSION
make --no-print-directory -s -f make/tool-versions.mk \
  --eval='nvkr-capi-version: ; @printf "%s\n" "$(CAPI_VERSION)"' \
  nvkr-capi-version > bin/CAPI_VERSION
tar --sort=name --format=ustar --mtime="@${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH:?}" \
  --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner --mode=u=rwX,go=rX \
  -cf - make/tool-versions.mk deploy/nvke-deploy.sh deploy/lib deploy/nico \
  cli/internal/bootstrap/sitespec/template.yaml \
  controller/deploy/charts/controller nktp/deploy/charts \
  controller/hack/apply-capi-spiffe-exec-auth.sh \
  controller/deploy/k8s/capi-spiffe-exec-auth \
  controller/test/fixtures/releases \
  controller/nico-sim/internal/seed/default-seed.yaml controller/nico-sim/ui \
  -C bin SOURCE_COMMIT CAPI_VERSION | gzip -n > bin/nvke-installer-sources.tar.gz
vendorCommand:
set -o pipefail
# Released NVKE pins still own their in-tree chart; preserve those exact bytes.
if [ -d nktp/deploy/charts/nktp ]; then
  exit 0
fi
# Admit the reviewed source-owned external chart selection before fetching.
release=deploy/nico/nktp/release.yaml
test "$(grep -c '^chart:' "$release")" = 1
chart=$(awk '/^chart:$/ { selected=1; next } selected && /^[^[:space:]#]/ { exit } selected { print }' "$release")
test "$chart" = '  name: nktp
  version: "0.2.0"
  repository: https://helm.ngc.nvidia.com/nvidia'
# Same NKTP pin as the nightly nktp-chart producer. The installer vendors this
# second source under ADR-22's single-source-closure contract.
nktp_repo=https://github.com/dsx-ai-factory/nvke-telemetry-pipeline.git
nktp_commit=dd1355c63ee37bb269f5a8669854af218907681c
nktp_tree=356ebc8d49f5fb2b0d618dfff0e69bb87d015c6d
source=$(mktemp -d /tmp/nvkr-nktp.XXXXXX)
git -C "$source" init --bare --quiet
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s git -C "$source" fetch --no-tags --depth=1 "$nktp_repo" "$nktp_commit"
test "$(git -C "$source" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$nktp_commit"
test "$(git -C "$source" rev-parse 'FETCH_HEAD^{tree}')" = "$nktp_tree"
git -C "$source" show "$nktp_commit:nktp/Chart.yaml" | grep -Fx 'version: 0.2.0'
git -C "$source" show "$nktp_commit:nvcb/chart/Chart.yaml" | grep -Fx 'version: 0.1.0'
mkdir -p nktp/deploy/charts
git -C "$source" archive "$nktp_commit" nktp nvcb/chart | tar -xf - -C nktp/deploy/charts

buildCommand:
export GOENV=off GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local
target_os="${GOOS:?}"
target_arch="${GOARCH:?}"
env -u GOOS -u GOARCH make -C cli build-cross DIST=bin NVKECTL_PLATFORMS="$target_os/$target_arch" \
  LEGACY_BINARY_NAME= NVKECTL_VERSION="git-${NKECTL_COMMIT}" NVKECTL_COMMIT="${NKECTL_COMMIT}" \
  NVKECTL_DATE="${NKECTL_DATE}" NVKECTL_TREE=clean
cp "cli/bin/nvkectl-$target_os-$target_arch" cli/bin/nvkectl
vendorCommand:
cd cli
export GOENV=off GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=
pins="$(sha256sum go.mod go.sum ../controller/api/go.mod ../controller/api/go.sum ../controller/deploy/charts/go.mod ../management-engine/go.mod ../management-engine/go.sum)"
timeout --kill-after=10s 540s go mod download
printf '%s\n' "$pins" | sha256sum --quiet -c -
GOPROXY=off timeout --kill-after=10s 60s go mod verify
GOPROXY=off timeout --kill-after=10s 180s go mod vendor
printf '%s\n' "$pins" | sha256sum --quiet -c -
